project.name: Understand-Anything
project.description: Egonex-AI/Understand-Anything — a Claude Code plugin that turns any codebase into an interactive knowledge graph. R2 (Direction A Why-deep) added LLM client + Why Story + Why Impact on top of R1's How/What persona stack.

nodes.name: WhyView.tsx
nodes.summary: Direction A — 5th persona's main view (R1 V3). R2 added the Stale Decisions banner via the why-impact module.

nodes.name: llm-client.ts
nodes.summary: R2 V1 — LLMProvider abstraction + retry + Zod-driven structured output. Zero runtime deps; works in browser and Node 20+.

nodes.name: why-story.ts
nodes.summary: R2 V6-V8 — Why Story generator with FNV-1a cache key, Zod-validated JSON, and stub fallback. Stores the story inside the ADR via a __story: tag token (no schema change).

nodes.name: why-impact.ts
nodes.summary: R2 V11-V12 — staleness scoring for ADRs (drift = file modified after decision date, normalised 0..1, bucketed fresh/aging/stale/ancient).

layers.name: Core
layers.description: L2 — analysis engine (R1 fingerprint, LLM, ADR).

layers.name: Dashboard
layers.description: L7 — UI views (graph, persona switcher, why view, etc).

tour.title: The WhyView
tour.description: Direction A's 5th persona lives here. Pick a decision on the left to read context, tradeoffs, and rejected alternatives. R2 added the LLM-generated Why Story above the meta block.

tour.title: The LLM client
tour.description: R2 V1: a tiny dependency-free LLMProvider interface. Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama are first-class providers; Zod-shaped structured output is built in.

tour.title: The Why Story pipeline
tour.description: R2 V6-V10: turn an ADR into a 1-paragraph plain-English retelling with 3 takeaways. Cached per (decision, language) via FNV-1a. Story is embedded into the ADR's tags as a __story: token, so it round-trips without a schema change.

tour.title: The Why Impact scorer
tour.description: R2 V11-V14: compute a 0..1 staleness score per ADR based on whether the files it references have been modified since the decision was made. UI: NodeInfo banner + FilterPanel toggle.
